title: Soft Actor-Critic (SAC): Off-Policy Maximum Entropy Deep Reinforcement Learning with a Stochastic Actor
description: Adds an entropy regularization term to the RL objective, encouraging policies that are both high-reward and high-entropy (exploratory). The temperature parameter α is automatically tuned. SAC is significantly more sample-efficient than TD3, more stable than DDPG, and generalizes better to new tasks. Dominant off-policy algorithm for continuous control.
